name: Marelli Holdings Co., Ltd.
note: Global automotive supplier, formerly KKR-owned. Filed for Chapter 11 in the US on 11 June 2025; the company expects to emerge in 2026 under the ownership of its principal lenders, named in its 29 July 2025 release as Deutsche Bank, Strategic Value Partners, MBK Partners, Fortress Investment Group and Polus Capital Management. Fortress is 68% owned by a consortium led by Mubadala Capital (Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund). No emergence announcement on marelli.com or marelliforward.com as of 4 October 2026, so the ultimate owner is unresolved (parentId null).
